ops.entry: WHEN a gate relies on this repository's run digests DO establish that required artifacts are tracked at the reviewed pin before crediting them as durable evidence — `runs/**` is gitignored by default, so local presence neither proves repository-state completeness nor survival after worktree removal.
ops.why: Main's feature-close observation reports missing ignored direct-run digests caused repository-state failure until tracked; QA c0 independently records the failed superseded run and green final pin. Existing G-02 overstates absence and survival as unconditional; replace with the weaker evidence-retention check, not a force-tracking workaround.

originals.original: WHEN planning to skim a prior run's evidence in this repository DO expect `runs/**` digests to be absent — they are gitignored, so a removed feature worktree takes every run digest with it, and only the `notes/` artifacts and the observations logs survive.
